setup_cmd: sed -i '/^  "bench"/d; /^  "regex-capi"/d; /^  "regex-debug"/d; /^  "regex-syntax"/d; s/aho-corasick = "0.6.0"/aho-corasick = "=0.6.4"/; s/memchr = "2.0.0"/memchr = "=2.0.1"/; s/thread_local = "0.3.2"/thread_local = "=0.3.5"/; s/utf8-ranges = "1.0.0"/utf8-ranges = "=1.0.0"/; s/lazy_static = "1"/lazy_static = "=1.0.0"/; s/quickcheck = { version = "0.6"/quickcheck = { version = "=0.6.2"/; s/rand = "0.4"/rand = "=0.4.2"/' Cargo.toml && if ! grep -q '^libc = "=0.2.40"$' Cargo.toml; then sed -i '/^\[dev-dependencies\]/a libc = "=0.2.40"' Cargo.toml; fi && cargo fetch --locked
notes: rust:1.40 (tc-rust). Default features only. Root library unit tests and the eight explicitly declared integration-test targets; auxiliary workspace crates, benches, examples and doc-tests are excluded. During setup, only in the disposable working copy, the four auxiliary workspace member lines are removed and dependency constraints are made exact before lockfile generation: the separate regex-benchmark crate pulls libpcre/tar/xattr dependencies unrelated to the library test oracle and incompatible with the era toolchain. The pristine repo is unchanged. Dependencies are pinned to versions available around the 2018-05-02 release and buildable by Rust 1.40: aho-corasick 0.6.4, memchr 2.0.1, thread_local 0.3.5, utf8-ranges 1.0.0, lazy_static 1.0.0, quickcheck 0.6.2, rand 0.4.2 and libc 0.2.40. RUSTFLAGS=--cap-lints=warn prevents the crate's test-only deny(warnings) from turning Rust 1.40 deprecation warnings for valid 2018 syntax into build errors. build_cmd touches src/*.rs so cargo never reuses a stale build after restore. Reproducibility: the exact dependency versions are fixed by the shipped lockfile benchmark/lockfiles/rust__regex.Cargo.lock, which `tc.py setup` copies into the working copy; setup_cmd then only downloads them (cargo fetch --locked). `setup_cmd_generate` is the original command that produced that lockfile in Oct 2026 (it resolves unpinned dependencies against the live registry, so it is kept for provenance only).
setup_cmd_generate: sed -i '/^  "bench"/d; /^  "regex-capi"/d; /^  "regex-debug"/d; /^  "regex-syntax"/d; s/aho-corasick = "0.6.0"/aho-corasick = "=0.6.4"/; s/memchr = "2.0.0"/memchr = "=2.0.1"/; s/thread_local = "0.3.2"/thread_local = "=0.3.5"/; s/utf8-ranges = "1.0.0"/utf8-ranges = "=1.0.0"/; s/lazy_static = "1"/lazy_static = "=1.0.0"/; s/quickcheck = { version = "0.6"/quickcheck = { version = "=0.6.2"/; s/rand = "0.4"/rand = "=0.4.2"/' Cargo.toml && if ! grep -q '^libc = "=0.2.40"$' Cargo.toml; then sed -i '/^\[dev-dependencies\]/a libc = "=0.2.40"' Cargo.toml; fi && rm -f Cargo.lock && cargo generate-lockfile && cargo fetch
